name: sofia-plugins
description: Sofia, a estrategista de roteiros para vídeos curtos, em português, espanhol e inglês. A Sofia Estrategista mais atual, a do curso Criador Estrategista, fica no marketplace criadores-do-futuro: Criadores-do-Futuro/sofia-estrategista (claude plugin marketplace add Criadores-do-Futuro/sofia-estrategista).

plugins.name: sofia-br
plugins.description: Writes, reviews and critiques short-form video scripts in Brazilian Portuguese using Sofia’s creator method: formats, script structures, hooks and plain-language rules. Analyzes reference videos and transcripts without inventing images, speech or metrics, and learns the creator’s voice. Read-only tools look up the method and flag points to review in a finished script. Frame-by-frame video prep needs FFmpeg. Sofia never posts or publishes anything.
